text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we win the Radio Nikkei Sho, a haughty little girl suddenly calls out to us.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: You there! Sakura Chiyono O, stop! You're a fan of Maruzensky, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: I'm Maruzensky's biggest fan! I've been her fan since three months ago!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't think this little girl could hurt Sakura Chiyono O, but I keep my eye on the situation anyway.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: You've got promise. Anyone who achieves the same feats as Maruzensky is worthy of my interest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! You watched me run in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: I don't just mean that race! I also saw you in the Tokyo Sports Hai Junior Stakes, and obviously the Radio Nikkei Sho just now…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! So you watched all the races that Maruzen won! And I just happened to place first in those races too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It all makes sense now… You really love Maruzen too, just like me! I have so much to talk about with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, the three of us somehow end up going to a ramen restaurant together.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Slurp, slurp. …And before I knew it, I was rooting for you as well. You ran pretty well in today's race, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow, thank you so much! I felt really good about today too, actually.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I think I really grasped the secrets of the mile, just like Maruzen…

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Wow… so everything you do is related to Maruzensky! Just like I thought, your passion is nothing like other run-of-the-mill Maruzensky fans!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: I'm guessing you'll be making your grand exit after competing in the sprint in Sapporo? That'll be quite an ending to your career. Hehe, then you can be my first fellow fan and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… no, it's way too soon for me to stop running. My main goal right now is the autumn Tenno Sho. I have to race there if I want to become Maruzen's rival.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Wait a second… Her rival? You're kidding. You want to go up against the Maruzensky?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Um, sorry if that wasn't clear…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't want to be her fan. I want to be her rival.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: What are you saying? I thought you loved her and looked up to her?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're right. I do love her. And that's why I want her to see me as a rival.
choice_data_list: She's working hard every day to make sure that happens.
She's working hard every day to make sure that happens.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Exactly. As you know, Maruzen's racing abilities are incredible. My skills are painfully mediocre compared to hers.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But even if I can't hold a candle to her, I swore to never give up. That's why I'm in the Twinkle Series now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And that's why I'm going to race in the autumn Tenno Sho, so I can show her how strong I am and light a fire in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: …I see. I guess we can't be fellow fangirls, then.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: You might love Maruzensky in a different way than I do, but I can tell you still love her…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The ramen was really good! Um…

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: I don't mind accepting you as Maruzensky's rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: I said, I accept you as her rival! You're strong and a hard worker!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Ribbon
text_block_list.text: So go become her greatest rival! Use your love for her to grow stronger, and make her feel that love!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow…
choice_data_list: Looks like she's rooting for you too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I never thought one of Maruzen's fans would acknowledge me as her rival…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you. It's such an honor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the girl turns and runs off, Sakura Chiyono O gives her a deep bow of respect and gratitude.
